"'''Best of My Love'''" is a song by American group [[the Emotions]] from their fourth studio album ''[[Rejoice (The Emotions album)|Rejoice]]'' (1977). Released as the album's lead single on June 9, 1977, the song topped both the US [[Billboard charts|''Billboard'']] [[Billboard Hot 100|Hot 100]] and US ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' [[Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs|R&B]] charts. It also reached the top five in the UK and Canada, the top 10 in New Zealand and the top 20 in Australia.

"Best of My Love" won a [[Grammy Award for Best R&B Performance by a Duo or Group with Vocals]] at the [[20th Annual Grammy Awards]] (1977). The tune also won an [[American Music Award for Best R&B Song|American Music Award for Favorite Soul/R&B Single]] at the [[American Music Awards of 1978]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.grammy.com/artists/emotions/14685 |title=Best R&B Performance by a Duo or Group with Vocals - The 20th Annual Grammy Awards (1977) |work=[[The Recording Academy]] |access-date=February 6, 2018 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180206231229/https://www.grammy.com/grammys/artists/emotions |archive-date=February 6, 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Emotions win Soul Single - AMA 1978|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t72UPqTON2s|access-date=April 1, 2025|via=[[YouTube]]|publisher=[[American Music Awards]] |publication-date=November 18, 2015}}</ref>

"Best of My Love" is a song by American group the Emotions from their fourth studio album Rejoice (1977). Released as the album's lead single on June 9, 1977, the song topped both the US Billboard Hot 100 and US Billboard R&B charts. It also reached the top five in the UK and Canada, the top 10 in New Zealand and the top 20 in Australia.

"Best of My Love" won a Grammy Award for Best R&B Performance by a Duo or Group with Vocals at the 20th Annual Grammy Awards (1977). The tune also won an American Music Award for Favorite Soul/R&B Single at the American Music Awards of 1978.

sections.heading: Background
sections.wikitext:
This tune was composed by [[Maurice White]] and [[Al McKay]] of [[Earth, Wind & Fire]], also produced by White and Clarence McDonald.<ref name=Song>{{cite AV media notes |title=Best of My Love|author=[[The Emotions]]|year=1977|type=single|publisher=[[Columbia Records]]}}</ref>

"Best of My Love" was originally published in the key of [[C major]] in [[Time signature#Characteristics|common time]] with a [[tempo]] of 120 beats per minute. The vocals span from C<sub>4</sub> to A<sub>5</sub> (although in the outro of the song, one of the Emotions hits a C<sub>6</sub>).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.musicnotes.com/sheetmusic/mtd.asp?ppn=MN0064194 |title=The Emotions - Best of My Love |website=musicnotes.com |date=25 March 2008 |access-date=April 28, 2018 }}</ref>

sections.heading: Commercial performance
sections.wikitext:
The single achieved huge success, remaining on top of the US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] chart for five non-consecutive weeks.<ref>{{cite web|url={{AllMusic|class=song|id=t825476|pure_url=yes}}|title=Best of My Love - The Emotions|work=[[AllMusic]]|access-date=April 13, 2008}}</ref> On the [[Dance Club Songs|disco chart]], "Best of My Love" peaked at number 11.<ref>{{cite book |title= Hot Dance/Disco: 1974-2003|last=Whitburn |first=Joel |author-link=Joel Whitburn |year=2004 |publisher=Record Research |page=89|isbn=978-0898201567}}</ref> 
The song was ranked at number 87 on "The ''Billboard'' Hot 100 All-Time Top Songs".<ref>{{cite magazine|url=http://www.billboard.com/bbcom/specials/hot100/charts/top100-titles-90.shtml|title=The Billboard Hot 100 All-Time Top Songs (90-81)|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|access-date=October 4, 2008|archive-date=September 13, 2008|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080913210027/http://www.billboard.com/bbcom/specials/hot100/charts/top100-titles-90.shtml}}</ref> As well this  was 1977's third biggest [[Pop music|pop]] hit and fifth biggest [[Contemporary R&B|R&B]] hit.<ref>{{cite magazine|url=http://www.billboard.com/bbcom/charts/yearend_chart_display.jsp?f=The+Billboard+Hot+100&g=Year-end+Singles&year=1977|title=The Billboard Hot 100 of 1977|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|access-date=March 8, 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061020155006/http://www.billboard.com/bbcom/charts/yearend_chart_display.jsp?f=The+Billboard+Hot+100&g=Year-end+Singles&year=1977|archive-date=October 20, 2006}}</ref><ref>{{cite magazine|url=http://www.billboard.com/bbcom/charts/yearend_chart_display.jsp?f=Hot+R%26B%2FHip-Hop+Songs&g=Year-end+Singles&year=1977|title=Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs of 1977|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|access-date=March 8, 2009|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20061020163617/http://www.billboard.com/bbcom/charts/yearend_chart_display.jsp?f=Hot+R&B%2FHip-Hop+Songs&g=Year-end+Singles&year=1977|archive-date=October 20, 2006|url-status=dead}}</ref> "Best of My Love" has been certified Platinum in the US by the [[Recording Industry Association of America|RIAA]] and Gold in the UK by the [[British Phonographic Industry|BPI]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.riaa.com/gold-platinum/?tab_active=default-award&ar=EMOTIONS&ti=BEST+OF+MY+LOVE|title=Gold & Platinum - RIAA|work=[[Recording Industry Association of America|RIAA]]|access-date=March 8, 2009}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=The Emotions: Best of My Love |url=https://www.bpi.co.uk/award/840-2006-1 |access-date=2025-04-01 |website=[[British Phonographic Industry|BPI]] |language=en}}</ref>
sections.text:
The single achieved huge success, remaining on top of the US Billboard Hot 100 chart for five non-consecutive weeks. On the disco chart, "Best of My Love" peaked at number 11. 
The song was ranked at number 87 on "The Billboard Hot 100 All-Time Top Songs". As well this  was 1977's third biggest pop hit and fifth biggest R&B hit. "Best of My Love" has been certified Platinum in the US by the RIAA and Gold in the UK by the BPI.

sections.heading: Critical reception
sections.wikitext:
Craig Lytle of [[AllMusic]] said of  "Best of My Love", "This spirited cut is seasoned with a fierce arrangement, in particular the horns, and incomparable vocals".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.allmusic.com/album/rejoice-mw0000203317|title=The Emotions: Rejoice|author=Lytle, Craig|publisher=[[AllMusic]]|website=allmusic.com}}</ref> [[Robert Hilburn]] of the ''[[Los Angeles Times]]'' described the tune as "one of the year's most delightful singles".<ref>{{cite news|title=International Disk Derby: Emphasis on Rock 'n' Roll|author=Hilburn, Robert|author-link=Robert Hilburn|page=82|date=October 2, 1977|newspaper=[[Los Angeles Times]]}}</ref>

''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' ranked the song at number one on their 2015 list of the Top 40 Biggest [[Girl group|Girl Group]] Songs of All Time on the ''Billboard'' Hot 100 chart.<ref>{{cite magazine |url=https://www.billboard.com/articles/pop-shop/girl-group-week/6070107/top-40-girl-group-songs-of-all-time |title=Top 40 Biggest Girl Group Songs of All Time on the Billboard Hot 100 Chart |magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]] |date=March 2, 2015 |access-date=September 4, 2018 }}</ref> ''Billboard'' also ranked the track at number 10 on their 2017 list of 100 Greatest Girl Group Songs of All Time.<ref>{{cite magazine|title=100 Greatest Girl Group Songs of All Time: Critics' Picks|url=https://www.billboard.com/media/lists/100-greatest-girl-group-songs-7857816/|magazine=Billboard|access-date=July 11, 2017}}</ref> In 2018, "Best of My Love" was ranked at number six on [[Heavy.com|Heavy]]'s list of Top 51 Best Love Songs: The Heavy Power List.<ref>{{cite web |last=Ryan |first=Sean |url=https://heavy.com/entertainment/2017/02/top-best-love-romantic-songs-list/ |title=Top 51 Best Love Songs: The Heavy Power List |website=[[Heavy.com]] |date=24 September 2018 |access-date=2 March 2019 }}</ref>
sections.text:
Craig Lytle of AllMusic said of  "Best of My Love", "This spirited cut is seasoned with a fierce arrangement, in particular the horns, and incomparable vocals". Robert Hilburn of the Los Angeles Times described the tune as "one of the year's most delightful singles".

Billboard ranked the song at number one on their 2015 list of the Top 40 Biggest Girl Group Songs of All Time on the Billboard Hot 100 chart. Billboard also ranked the track at number 10 on their 2017 list of 100 Greatest Girl Group Songs of All Time. In 2018, "Best of My Love" was ranked at number six on Heavy's list of Top 51 Best Love Songs: The Heavy Power List.

sections.heading: Covers and samples
sections.wikitext: "Best of My Love" has been covered by [[Mary J. Blige]], [[Ella Eyre]], [[Sheena Easton]], [[Unchain]] and [[Samantha Jade]].<ref name=Genius>{{cite web|url=https://genius.com/The-emotions-best-of-my-love-lyrics|title=Best of My Love: The Emotions|website=[[Genius.com]]}}</ref> It has been sampled by [[De La Soul]], [[Lisa Lisa and Cult Jam]], [[Girl Talk (musician)|Girl Talk]], [[Kylie Minogue]], [[C+C Music Factory]], [[Keyshia Cole]], [[Mariah Carey]], [[B-Rock and the Bizz]] and [[Tamia]].<ref name=Genius /> The song was also sampled in [[Paul Russell (musician)|Paul Russell]]'s 2023 single, "[[Lil Boo Thang]]" from his EP ''Again Sometime?''.<ref name="BB1">{{cite magazine|url=https://www.billboard.com/music/chart-beat/paul-russell-hot-100-debut-lil-boo-thang-1235425997/|title=Hot 100 First-Timers: Paul Russell's 'Lil Boo Thang' Gets Bigger With Debut|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|last=Zellner|first=Xander|date=September 26, 2023|access-date=September 27, 2023}}</ref>
sections.text: "Best of My Love" has been covered by Mary J. Blige, Ella Eyre, Sheena Easton, Unchain and Samantha Jade. It has been sampled by De La Soul, Lisa Lisa and Cult Jam, Girl Talk, Kylie Minogue, C+C Music Factory, Keyshia Cole, Mariah Carey, B-Rock and the Bizz and Tamia. The song was also sampled in Paul Russell's 2023 single, "Lil Boo Thang" from his EP Again Sometime?.
